unread_or_uncertain_spans.exact_question: What letters form the cluster between the first readable དང and the following དང in row 1?
What is the complete initial stack immediately before ཅིང་རྒྱུག in row 1?
After final ལས, how many short tiered strokes accompany the upright, and which strokes are independent of the word and right rule?
What letters occupy the interval between མཛེས་ཞིང and ལྡན་པ་ལ?
What is the complete row-end text after བག་ཡངས་རྣམ་ཤེས, before the next row's པར?
What is the stack between བྱ་དང and པ་བྲལ?
What letters and suffix occur after ཁྱད་པར and before པདྨ་ལས?
Inventory the entire interval after མེད and before ང་ནི: which uprights are detached bars, and which belong to adjacent letters?
What, if any, lexical ending follows དགའ་བྱེད before the closing bar?
What is the complete cluster after དབང་ཕྱུག and before ལུས?
How many detached bars occur in the whole interval between རྙེད and དེ་ཚེ, excluding their attached limbs?
What are the letters between རྩ་བཞིའི and ནི?
What is the syllable between རྡོ་རྗེ and དང?
What attached ending, if any, follows the second སོ before ལས?
How many detached upright strokes occupy the complete interval from གསང to དངོས་གྲུབ, after separating letter limbs?
What is the initial row-3 cluster before པ་གྲོལ་བར་ངེས, continuing the preceding གང་སུ?
What main-sized letters follow ངེས, excluding the adjacent smaller strokes?
What are the small strokes within the pale rounded area, and is their attachment to the main sequence recoverable?
What syllable follows བརྗོད and precedes མེད?
What complete cluster follows ནམ་མཁའ་མི and precedes བར་སྣང་ལས?
What letters stand between དགུ and ཡི་ཡང་སྟེང་ནས?
What is the complete particle after ཀུན and before བཅུད, including any final consonant?
What is the left marginal mark's actual graph or text? No numeral or lexical value is assumed.
Is there a detached terminal bar after ལས distinguishable from the final letter and nearby right frame?
How many rounded/downturned components form the isolated train after its leading bar, and are any joined?
